Court sentences man to death for rape and murder of child

A court in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, has awarded the death penalty to an individual accused of the rape and murder of a three-year-old girl. The case was heard under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. This sentencing highlights the legal system's response to severe crimes against children.
